quality_questions.switch_while_generating: Progress and result stay in the session that started the job: running cards render only where attempt_id matches; the other session shows 「<标题>」正在生成图片 + 回到该会话; after settle the other session has 0 attempts (test_running_job_stays_in_its_session_while_viewing_another; image_pane.test.js D-82/D-87 case).
quality_questions.seed_word: DOM_CHECKS asserts no 「种子」 in visible text, title, aria-label or placeholder outside details.image-advanced / details.attempt-advanced in every checked state at both viewports; image_session.test.js checks every main-flow string.
quality_questions.failed_cancelled_reason: failed / cancelled / interrupted / missing cards render an icon block (no ), a badge and the reason; asserted in e2e (attempt-failed, attempt-cancelled, attempt-interrupted, attempt-file-missing) with blank_images 0.
quality_questions.narrow_900x700: Every state is checked at 900x700: no horizontal scroll, no clipped buttons, no overlap between session list, head, timeline and composer, nothing past the viewport edge.

found_and_fixed_during_self_check: Screenshots showed 「正在生成这个会话里的第 N 次」 after the attempt had already settled (the 2 s job poll lagged the session file). loadSession now treats the session file as authoritative; e2e asserts the hint clears within 1.5 s (mutation-checked: removing the fix fails 2 e2e tests).
A new session created in the same second as the previous update could sort below it; orderSessions puts the freshly created one first on ties (D-60).
library routes return {error: "<原因>"} strings; api.js now surfaces that text as the DeskApiError message so rename/delete/404 reasons reach the user.
